description:
Driven by curiosity and a passion for exploration, we are a group of high school students taking part in the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal is to bring fresh perspectives, creativity, and scientific thinking to the challenges of space exploration. We believe that great discoveries begin with bold questions and the courage to explore the unknown.

Team ASTROCHIEF 🚀
summary:
Mars Map is a mission-support platform designed to help future astronauts make safer exploration decisions on Mars. Although NASA has collected vast planetary data, it remains scattered across different platforms. Our project integrates surface imagery, elevation data, and USGS–NASA geological maps into a single mapping environment.

Users can compare routes based on terrain slope, ground conditions, estimated travel time, and oxygen consumption. The system includes a BuddyTrack concept to monitor crew and rover locations, offline map access for communication blackouts, and simulated hazard alerts. We use Jezero Crater (Perseverance data) as our primary area and Gale Crater (Curiosity data) as a reference region, keeping all measurements tied to their exact missions.

Built with React, TypeScript, CesiumJS/MapLibre, and Python (FastAPI), Mars Map prioritizes human crew needs—resource limits, coordination, and safe return—turning complex Mars data into actionable mission plans.
details:
Mars Map is a mission-support concept designed to help future astronauts plan safer and more informed journeys across the Martian surface. It brings together NASA's terrain images, elevation data and geological information in a shared mapping environment. Users can compare routes by considering slope, ground conditions, estimated travel time and oxygen consumption. The project also explores crew tracking through BuddyTrack, offline map access and simulated hazard alerts.

Our primary testing area is Jezero Crater, using data from NASA's Perseverance mission, while Gale Crater serves as a separate reference region. We use resources such as NASA Mars Trek, USGS geological maps and Perseverance images.

Mars Map focuses on turning existing scientific data into practical mission-planning information, with particular attention to crew coordination, limited communication and resource management.
